bio.summary: Chaneque Ranger Poco is a fictional chaneque (forest ranger) standup performer. Knee-high Veracruz forest ranger. Finds lost kids, feeds them sweet food and milk, and returns them unbothered while search parties collect scratches. The act circles the paved mile and the lost influencer. Onstage the register is bright.
